description: Groundwork dependency updates use the daily self-hosted runner in jasondockery/renovate-config. The shared preset evaluates routine updates for branch and PR creation on every daily run after the applicable five-day maturity floor, and explicitly bypasses the routine schedule, age floor, and rate limits for vulnerability alerts. Pins, digests, and manual surfaces use the controls in dependency-coverage.json. The canonical end-to-end acceptance contract lives at renovate-config/specs/renovate-system-acceptance.md.

Groundwork's managed surfaces are GitHub Actions SHA pins, Dockerfile image tags/digests, the tagged-and-digested Gitleaks workflow container, and the primary Python version in the managed mise configuration. GHCR does not expose a Renovate releaseTimestamp for the Gitleaks tags, so that exact dependency uses its inventoried immutable-digest, CI, and owner-review controls instead of the timestamp-based age check. Only groundwork-specific rules stay local; the wider non-major group below includes digest and pin updates because several surfaces are immutable pins, not semver ranges. A green runner scan is not Groundwork compatibility proof — an eligible PR must pass Groundwork CI.

.nvmrc and mise.toml stay ignored because tools/sync-toolchain.mjs rewrites those Node mirrors from .node-version. A second Node update there would fight the derived mirror. home/dot_config/mise/config.toml is not ignored: Renovate's mise manager reads it. node = "lts" is disabled so the alias is not replaced by a numbered release on every LTS move; update-all already floats that alias under mise's five-day floor. The mise manager updates only the first entry of an array, so python = ["3.13", "3.12"] leaves 3.12 untouched for Aider (audioop). A package rule also refuses the bump if 3.12 is ever the extracted current value. Python line-bump Dependency Dashboard approval is not configured here. It belongs to preset github>jasondockery/renovate-config#1.1.0, which is not tagged yet, so extends stays on #1.0.0. postUpgradeTasks fileFilters stay the Node adapters that command rewrites. A Python edit in the managed mise config does not select that task.

packageRules.description: package.json engines.node is derived from .node-version and must never create a mirror-only branch.
GHCR does not expose releaseTimestamp for Gitleaks tags; rely on its immutable digest, required CI, and owner review instead of leaving every update pending forever.
Ubuntu base-image majors change Groundwork's supported platform contract; require explicit Dependency Dashboard approval before branch and PR creation.

The managed mise config pins Node to the lts alias. Replacing that alias with a numbered release would open a churn PR on every LTS move. update-all already floats the alias under mise's five-day release-age floor.

Aider still imports audioop, which Python 3.13 removed, so the 3.12 entry in python = ["3.13", "3.12"] must stay pinned. Renovate's mise manager (44.23.0) updates only the first array entry and does not read 3.12 while it stays second. If 3.12 is ever extracted as the current value, do not propose a bump.
